title: memory.replace request
description: Change only the supplied fields of a memory fact.

seen_version.description: The fact's version as the writer read it. Agents must send it; a person's own command may leave it out and then acts on the fact the number names (README, "Covered changes").

metadata_json.description: JSON text encoding a metadata object. Apply the bank's max_metadata_chars and exclude reserved import provenance from public replies.

clear_expiry.description: Clear the expiry, as invalid_after_utc=never does today. Do not also send expires.
